description: Mainnet addresses that were missing from deployments/*.json on main. They were recovered from the working copy of this repository on the retired server 216.106.176.191 (checked out at b29f91e, with uncommitted deployments/*.json edits) before the server was shut down. They are kept here as a record only. Nothing loads this file: deployments/index.ts reads deployments/ only.
verifiedOnChain: 2026-11-25. Code is present at every address and the native balance is 0; ownerOnChain is the value owner() returned. The same address can appear on two chains because the deployer used the same nonce on each.
